title: Donated 100 acre Texas ranch becomes $145mn Odessa complex
summary_full: A Texas family's generous land gift is becoming a major sports and recreation complex. This $145 million project will serve as a neighborhood hub and tournament destination. Construction is progressing towards a significant milestone with a topping-out ceremony next month. The expansive facility will feature numerous indoor courts and outdoor fields for various sports. This new complex promises to draw visitors and boost local economic growth.
